description: This is a PHP source file defining a database migration class for version 4.3.4 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains logic to create a new database table 'ohrm_employee_subscription' if it does not already exist.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class responsible for creating the 'ohrm_employee_subscription' database table during system upgrade to version 4.3.4.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Creates the 'ohrm_employee_subscription' table with columns 'id', 'employee_id', 'status', and 'created_at' if it does not exist.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number '4.3.4' of this migration.
